request: split the airbnb four ways and show who still owes me

expect.why: An even split with a per-member settled marker. "still owes me" is a derived view from the perspective of one member, and render never knows who is viewing — so the app has to show every pair, not "you".

notes: The render-never-knows-the-viewer rule is easy to violate here and invisible to the gate, because an app that says "you owe" renders perfectly well. Rubric check 7.
